Foundation covers upper-primary skills.Stretch adds harder extension questions.

Question freshness: Exact questions remain protected throughout saved history; precise tasks and parent-equivalent methods remain protected within each exact setting while enough unused validated content remains. This standalone release checks availability before Start and documents a protected per-setting horizon of up to 12 focused 12-question papers, 8 focused 30-question papers and 2 focused 60-question papers; Mixed-topic horizons are 20, 12 and 4 respectively. Clearing saved data deliberately resets this protection.
